verdict.rationale: Poke's docs list built-in Email Management (read, search, and draft emails) and Calendar (schedule meetings, check availability). A general Integrations/Recipes system lets Poke access information across connected apps through conversation, and any MCP-compatible server can be connected. However, no cloud drive connector (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox) is named anywhere in the evidence, so a third of the story is unproven. missing for 10: a documented cloud-drive connector with file search, and independent or hands-on corroboration of email/calendar search being used in answers.
